vulnerability.name: GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf
vulnerability.description: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs

statements.impact_statement: picomatch 4.0.7 has no patched version. It is a transitive development dependency, reached through fdir and tinyglobby from typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-import-x, eslint-plugin-tsdoc, knip, vite and vitest, all of which are devDependencies. The plugin declares no runtime dependency, its hooks and CLI import no package, and the release tarball is a git archive of this repository, which holds no node_modules. Nothing that ships, or that runs on a user's machine, loads picomatch.
